Citation rule for every test written below: cite this spec's requirements in the qualified form
`scoped-fr-citations/FR-NNN` (with real digits), and NEVER write a literal qualified token for a
fixture spec into `tests/smoke.sh`: `printf '%s/FR-…' "$a"` leaves the token `s/FR-…` in the source,
and an unquoted `$a/FR-…` leaves `a/FR-…`. Only `"$a"/FR-…` (closing quote right before the `/`) is safe.
Put that sentence in a comment above the first fixture (plan step 8).
